## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Pipeline Checklist

- [ ] Canonical references and `docs/STATE.md` reflect the change.
- [ ] Durable decisions recorded in ADRs, or not applicable.
- [ ] New top-level docs indexed with a justifying ADR, or not applicable.
- [ ] Completed plans folded into canonical homes and deleted.
- [ ] Shared-contract changes coordinated with their owner, or not applicable.
- [ ] Appropriate verification run; documentation gate is `git diff --check`.

## Verification

Describe checks run and any material limitation. Follow `docs/conventions.md` for the current gate; do not claim runtime checks for documentation-only work.
